name: sirpyairtravels
description: Sirpy Air Travels — static website for sirpyairtravels.com

comments.no-build: This is a plain static site. There is deliberately no build script, so Vercel serves the repository root as-is with no install or compile step.
comments.tools: The images/pages scripts are local maintenance helpers and need sharp: npm i sharp. They are not run during deployment.
